entries.name: Rift Keys

p: A key has a tier (1-15) and up to 3 modifiers. Modifiers on a drop: 1: 50%, 2: 35%, 3: 15%.
The modifiers make the rift harder and raise its rewards: quantity, rarity, experience, at most +80%/+75%/+60% (raised by tier IV and V modifiers).

rows: 45% + 10% per modifier (at most 75%) for a next key; 60% + 10% per modifier of those are one tier higher.
Rare 4%, legendary 10%: a key of the rift's tier.
Tier-1 keys: 0.25% per kill (Normal x1, Magic x3, Rare x8, Legendary x20, Boss x40) from monsters of hunting level 60 or more and at least 40% of yours.
Tier-1 key for a finished contract: hunt 25%, elite 50%, boss 100%.
Gives a Rift Key without modifiers one modifier.
Gives a Rift Key without modifiers two or three modifiers.

Removes one random modifier of a Rift Key.

entries.sub: Where keys come from and the orbs that work on them.

entries.name: Rift Tiers and Rewards

p: Tiers above 10 reuse the last window: +25 levels to enter and +15% health, damage and +10% rewards per tier.

Every rift is a new generated map: a cave system, an open waste, a ruined complex or a cave with ruined chambers, sometimes on two floors, with the guardian's arena in the far corner. Its size follows the key's tier: tiers 1-5 144 x 144 tiles, 16 minutes; tiers 6-10 176 x 176 tiles, 18 minutes; tiers 11-15 208 x 208 tiles, 21 minutes.
The guardian comes after 75% of the monsters; 3 shared lives + 1 per extra player; up to 5 players.

About 216 monsters solo at tier 1 up to 612 at tier 15 on a map of typical size (+25% per extra player; a bigger map holds more), in packs of 5-7 over the whole map; about 148-243 alive at once, the rest gather ahead of you as you advance. Most monsters are husks: experience only. Magic and better monsters always carry loot, so a run drops about what fewer, tougher packs did.

Each extra player: +100% monster health in total (more packs, tougher monsters), +100% guardian health, +10% damage taken; every finisher's chest +12.5% (at most +50%) and +5% kill loot (at most +20%).
Gold: 5000 x tier squared to the bank.
Orb of Upheaval: 0.5 + 0.085 per tier; Orb of Fate: 0 + 0.06 per tier.
Item rolls: 2 + 0.5 per tier from the rift monsters' loot, gear with a rarity; one currency roll and one unique roll.
Gems and spell supports too (Gems and Supports tabs). Gold, orbs and rolls x (1 + quantity bonus).

entries.sub: Level to enter, monsters and the chest of each tier.

entries.name: Omens

p: Rifts of tier 6 or more give omen fragments; 60 fragments bind an Omen Key of a random kind. The key opens that guardian's arena (level 800, 12 minutes, the rift's lives). Omen keys have no modifiers.

3000 x your level in gold to the bank, 4 Orb of Upheaval, 2 Orb of Fate, 8 item rolls of the guardian's loot (x1.5 rarity), 2 unique rolls (x2 find), gems and supports as a tier 15 rift. Drops in the arena get +15 item level.

entries.name: The professions

p: Four gathering professions, each with its own level 1-100: Delving (ore veins), Wortcunning (herb patches), Flaying (corpses of beasts and reptiles) and Angling (fishing). They make no gear and no orbs: what you gather is sold to a Material Broker (one stands next to every temple; in Cinderhold in the teleport room's market).
Every profession level above 1 adds 0.0253% experience from monsters, all four together at most +10% (every profession at 100).

sections.h: Experience bonus with all four at a level

p: Each week every material gets one of the demand multipliers x1.5, x1.25, x1, x1, x0.75 (Economy > Professions shows the week's board). Per material and day the broker pays the full price for 100 units, then 50% of it up to 200, then takes no more until the next day.

entries.name: How items work

p: Items come in seven rarities: Common, Uncommon, Magic, Rare, Legendary, Divine and Unique. Gear can carry one of the first six; a unique has fixed stats of its own. The rarity decides how many modifiers a new item gets and how many prefixes and suffixes it may carry.
Every item has an item level (1-150) from where it dropped. The item level decides which tiers its modifiers can roll: T1 (lowest) to T8 (highest).
Prefixes are damage and defence, suffixes utility, resistances and speed.
Orbs change items (Orbs tab); the crafting bench shows what each would do. Legendary powers roll only from Legendary.
Uniques have fixed stats and are never changed by orbs.

entries.sub: Rarity, item level, tiers, prefixes and suffixes in short.

entries.name: Uniques

p: A unique is a named item with fixed stats. No orb changes it.
Every unique has one power of its own, the orange block under its text. It is not a stat: it changes how you play.
The power works only for the classes listed after "For:" in its text. A unique with no "For:" works for every class. A class line includes its ascended classes.
Every class its class row allows can wear the item. When your class is not on the power's list, the power sleeps and only the stats count.
The tooltip tells which it is: "Works for your class." or "Asleep: your class is not in its list."

sections.h: How many powers work at once
p: At most 5 unique powers work at once, and only one of each family. A family is a kind of effect: two uniques of the same kind do not add up.
When two worn uniques share a family, the stronger one wins (the one with the higher level) and the other sleeps.
The tooltip of a unique you wear says "Active." or tells why its power sleeps.
Monsters: magic, rare, legendary and boss monsters can drop a unique, at most 1 per kill. Normal monsters never do.

A leveling unique (level 700 or lower, no minimum monster level) also drops from most monsters near its level: from 90% of its level up to 2 times its level plus 10. In a hunt of the right level that is about 1 unique in 1500 to 2500 kills (before item find).
An endgame unique (it has a minimum monster level) drops from any monster of that level or higher, at 50% of its chance.
A character of level 60 or lower finds a unique of its class at kill number 150, once per character.
Bosses, world bosses, rift and Omen chests, the raid, the Ember Descent and the Conquest vendor give uniques too. The page of a unique lists how it can be found.
Hover over a unique to read it. Hold Ctrl to compare it with the item you wear in that slot. Hold Alt to read what each line means.
Right-click a unique and choose Open in Codex to open its page here, or Where to find to see where it drops.

entries.sub: What a unique is, what its power does and where it comes from.

entries.name: Rarity

p: New = modifiers on a new item; Sides = most prefixes (and suffixes); Max = what the Orb of Grafting fills up to; Binds = bound modifiers allowed; Quality = Whetstone cap; Sockets = most sockets by rarity.
Legendary powers: from Legendary, 1 per item.

entries.sub: Modifier counts and limits per rarity.

entries.name: Tiers

p: A modifier rolls among every tier its item level allows. Each tier weighs 1.35 times the one below it (T1 100, T8 816), so the best tier the item level allows is the most likely one, and the lowest still rolls. A few modifiers have a gate of their own (the weapon's Mana Leech does not roll below T4).

entries.sub: T1-T8: the item level each tier needs and the odds.

entries.name: Item level

p: A drop's item level follows the monster's level along the curve below (straight lines in between), then: Normal +0, Magic +2, Rare +4, Legendary +7, Boss +10; inside a rift +1 per rift tier (at most +15); an Omen arena +15 more; at most 150.
Fixed: world boss drops and rewards 145, store gear 60, the tutorial's gear 5.
Orbs keep the item level.

entries.sub: Where the item level of a drop comes from.

entries.name: Prefixes and suffixes

p: Prefixes: damage and defence (skills, critical hits, weapon elements, armour, block, dodge, reflect, thorns, penetration, ailments, maximum life and mana...).

Suffixes: utility, resistances and speed (the four resistances, spell suppression, physical reduction, leech, attack and movement speed, life and mana on kill or hit, mana regeneration, attributes, experience...).
A new item is rolled until its count or both sides are full; the Orb of Grafting only adds on a side that is open. An Orb of Ruin can give one extra slot on one side.

entries.sub: What a prefix and a suffix are.

entries.name: How you defend

p: 1. Avoidance, for hits only (never a burn, poison or a field): dodge for attacks (a monster's melee and ranged attacks, a player's weapon hits), block for attacks, spell suppression for spells (a suppressed spell deals 50% less).
2. Mitigation by damage type: a physical hit loses its armour share plus your physical reduction (at most 90% together); fire, cold, lightning and chaos hits lose their resistance.
3. Then the other bonuses (damage taken from monsters, blessings, gems, charms, sets ...), the mana shield, the energy shield and your health. Last Breath works last of all.
Armour takes A / (A + 0.07 x H) off a physical hit of size H: a lot of a small hit, little of a big one.
A is the armour of the pieces you wear plus the Armour modifier. The passive tree's and the items' physical reduction add to the armour share.
Fire: fire. Cold: ice, water, drowning. Lightning: energy, holy, arcane. Chaos: earth, death, life drain, mana drain. Physical is not a resistance: it has armour and the physical reduction.
Every source adds up (gear, the passive tree, Paragon, item sets, gems, charms); all elements count for Fire, Cold and Lightning, not for Chaos.
The passive tree and Paragon count 50% of their points toward a resistance, at most 30 points from the tree; gear, sets, gems and charms count in full.

The penalty by level (level 250: -30, level 500: -60) comes off the sum; the result is held at 75 (a rift modifier can lower that); a player attacker's penetration comes off after that, down to -100. A negative resistance raises the damage you take.
You are told at login and when you level up between 240 and 249 and between 490 and 499, and when you cross a mark.
The character sheet (Info & Services > Character Info, and Inspect Player) shows each resistance with its sum, the penalty and the result, the armour, dodge, block and spell suppression.

entries.sub: The order of a hit on your character, the four resistances and the armour.

entries.name: Conquest Tokens

p: Every boss you help slay (damage, last hit, or a party member within range), every sealed rift, dungeon clear, Ember Descent run and invasion reward gives Conquest Tokens. Each source has a daily limit; the window's Progress tab shows today's tokens.

Iselde Varrow in the teleport room's market. Any unique or set piece is for sale once it dropped for you, once you slew a monster that drops it, or when its level is at most your level + 50. A bought item is made like a drop. Grasp of the Pyre Saint is always on sale.

The Cinderheart chain: an Omen Key of the kind you choose (150), your Omen Key attuned to another kind (40), an Ascended Shard of the kind you choose (300); 2 shards or 2 relics of one kind become one of another.
Refinement: a worn item with a rarity rises one rarity (up to Legendary), keeps every modifier and gains one; 60 + 60 x the new rarity tokens.
Salvage: a unique on the bench gives 10% of its price in tokens (at least 25).
Each miss of a roll raises your next chance of that group; a drop starts the count again. Perfect rolls and the top rarities stay luck.

entries.sub: The sure path: tokens for every boss and clear, any item you have seen for sale.

entries.name: Quality, binding and ruin

p: Each Whetstone adds 1% quality, up to 20% (30% from Divine). Quality multiplies the base bonus the rarity gave the item (its attack, defence and armour) by (100 + quality) / 100, rounded; it does not change a modifier.
A bound modifier is left alone by Tempering, Unmaking, Excision, Reforging and Upheaval. Only an Orb of Erasure frees it (and wipes the item). An item with a bound modifier refuses the Orb of Fate.

The Void Orb corrupts a Rare or better item for good: no orb changes it afterwards, and the tooltip shows Corrupted. Then: 28% nothing else happens, 20% a modifier rises one tier, 20% a corrupted implicit modifier, 8% quality 30%, 7% one more socket (up to 3), 8% every modifier rolls again, 4% one rarity up (up to Divine), 5% a modifier falls 2 tiers. A locked or store item is refused.

The Orb of Ruin: 40% the item improves (60% of those one tier more on every unbound modifier, else an extra modifier above the side limit, once per item), 60% nothing happens. It never ruins an item (items ruined before stay ruined). For a sure step up, the Conquest vendor's refinement raises a worn item one rarity (up to Legendary), keeps its modifiers and adds one.

entries.sub: Whetstones, bound modifiers and the Orb of Ruin.

entries.name: Pack combat

p: Hunting monsters have much less health and come in bigger packs. Pull a group and kill it together: area spells and cleaves matter.

Experience and loot per kill are lower by the same share, so experience and gold per hour stay where they were. Kill counts (bounties, bestiary, tasks, achievements) need more kills by the same share.
Multikill: kills each within 3 s of the one before form a chain; the whole chain's experience gets 4 kills +10%, 6 kills +20%, 8 kills +30%, 9 kills +40%.
Bosses, rifts, the Ember Descent, the tower, invasions, arena, battleground and PvP are not changed.

Health, experience per kill, loot per kill and the monster's damage to you, in percent of the monster's own numbers. Monsters with a level of their own (late game, generated areas and dungeons) use the second set, on top of the health and experience their level already gives them.

A direct hit on a hunting monster, yours or your summon's, also deals a share of it to monsters within 1 sqm of it (never bosses, players or their summons), so every class kills packs. The share goes from the first number at level 300 and below to the second at level 1000 and above.

entries.sub: Monsters come in packs and die fast: kill groups, not one at a time.

entries.name: Pocket bosses

p: The world bosses, the island bosses and the random raid bosses each have a pocket: a private arena with that boss, opened any time with the Pocket button of the Boss Spawns window, alone or with your party.
Every character has 3 charges a day per boss (new ones at 00:00); every party member spends one. Bonus charges stay over the reset (at most 6 held, 3 added a day).

The boss is scaled to the party. It pays less than the scheduled fight: experience and loot are cut (even the always-dropped items are not sure), and world bosses give a smaller share of their event reward with one roll of their set.
The boss passive point counts for a pocket kill as for any other kill: no one is locked out by the clock.
A lethal hit carries you out without dying; the charge stays spent. After a boss's event rewarded you, its pocket waits 60 minutes.
Island and raid bosses spawned in the world: every helper whose damage and healing reach 2% of the boss's health gets a personal loot roll, not only the corpse owner.

entries.sub: A private copy of a time-gated or contested boss, any time, for less reward.

entries.name: Base stat bonus

p: An item with a rarity also gets a small bonus to its attack, defence, armour and hit chance, once: min + item level x (max - min + 1) / 100.

entries.sub: Attack, defence, armour and hit chance from the rarity.

entries.name: The Fall of the Cinders

p: No one agrees on the night it happened. The sky split, and burning stones fell like slow rain for a season. Where they struck, the ground remembered fire: forests turned to ash, the dead stirred in their graves, and the first rifts opened like wounds that would not close.
The Cinders still lie where they fell. Some are cold. Some still beat.

Ninguém concorda sobre a noite em que aconteceu. O céu se partiu e pedras em chamas caíram como uma chuva lenta por uma estação inteira. Onde tocaram, a terra lembrou o fogo: florestas viraram cinza, os mortos se agitaram nos túmulos e as primeiras fendas se abriram como feridas que não fecham.
As Brasas ainda estão onde caíram. Algumas esfriaram. Outras ainda pulsam.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Isle of First Blood

p: Every newcomer wakes on the same small island, among statues no one remembers carving. The Vigil says the island was the first place a Cinder did not burn. Whatever the truth, nothing there can kill you, and nothing there will follow you out.

Todo recém-chegado acorda na mesma pequena ilha, entre estátuas que ninguém lembra de ter esculpido. A Vigília diz que a ilha foi o primeiro lugar onde uma Brasa não queimou. Seja qual for a verdade, nada ali pode matar você, e nada dali o seguirá.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Archivist's Ledger

p: Archivist Maelis keeps a ledger of every name the fire gave back: bosses, rifts, Omens, the things in the deep. She pays for true accounts and burns the false ones. Her ink is mixed with ash, so that what is written cannot be unwritten.

A Arquivista Maelis mantém um registro de cada nome que o fogo devolveu: chefes, fendas, Presságios, as coisas das profundezas. Ela paga por relatos verdadeiros e queima os falsos. Sua tinta é misturada com cinza, para que o que foi escrito não possa ser apagado.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Rifts

p: A rift is a place that fell with a Cinder and never finished landing. Step through with a key and you walk a piece of somewhere else, for as long as it holds. Each one has a guardian. Seal it, and the rift closes. Leave it open, and it remembers your face.

Uma fenda é um lugar que caiu com uma Brasa e nunca terminou de pousar. Atravesse com uma chave e você caminha por um pedaço de outro lugar, enquanto ele durar. Cada uma tem um guardião. Sele-a e a fenda se fecha. Deixe-a aberta e ela lembrará do seu rosto.

entries.sub: Rifts

entries.name: Abyssal Rift

p: Floors of black glass over nothing at all. The Veiled Choir hears singing down there and answers it. What lives in the Abyssal Rift has too many eyes, and it has learned to close the ones you are looking at.
Pisos de vidro negro sobre o nada. O Coro Velado ouve um canto lá embaixo e responde. O que vive na Fenda Abissal tem olhos demais, e aprendeu a fechar aqueles para os quais você olha.

entries.sub: Rifts

entries.name: Obsidian Hall

p: A hall of black marble that was never built by hands. Magma runs in its seams like veins. The Cinderforge Compact mines its walls between waves of the things that guard it, and calls the losses the price of good steel.

Um salão de mármore negro que nunca foi construído por mãos. O magma corre em suas juntas como veias. O Pacto da Forja de Brasa minera suas paredes entre as ondas de guardiões, e chama as perdas de preço do bom aço.

entries.sub: Rifts

entries.name: Ashen Crypt

p: Graves that burned without being opened. The dead inside woke warm and angry. The Ashen Vigil rings its bells at every crypt that stirs, and sends wardens with oil and torches to finish what the fire started.

Túmulos que queimaram sem serem abertos. Os mortos lá dentro acordaram quentes e furiosos. A Vigília Cinzenta toca seus sinos em cada cripta que se agita e envia guardiões com óleo e tochas para terminar o que o fogo começou.

entries.sub: Rifts

entries.name: Forsaken Sanctum

p: A gilded temple swallowed by fungus. Its priests prayed for the fire to pass them by, and something answered with rot instead. The Thornbound Circle cuts the blight back every season. Every season it grows faster.

Um templo dourado engolido por fungos. Seus sacerdotes rezaram para que o fogo passasse longe, e algo respondeu com podridão. O Círculo dos Espinhos corta a praga a cada estação. A cada estação ela cresce mais rápido.

entries.sub: Rifts

entries.name: The Omens

p: Some rifts do not hold a guardian. They hold a herald. The fragments they leave can be pressed into a key, and the key opens a door to the Omen itself: Sangrith of the Bloodmoon, Morvane the Hollow Crown, Thalcyra the Stormbound Seer. Each one foretells the same thing in a different voice.

Algumas fendas não guardam um guardião. Guardam um arauto. Os fragmentos que deixam podem ser prensados em uma chave, e a chave abre a porta para o próprio Presságio: Sangrith da Lua de Sangue, Morvane a Coroa Oca, Thalcyra a Vidente da Tempestade. Cada um prevê a mesma coisa com uma voz diferente.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: Sangrith the Bloodmoon Herald

p: Sangrith walked out of the red night that followed the first fall, carrying a sickle of moonlight. He harvests what the fire missed. Those who fight him say the floor fills with blood before anyone is cut.

Sangrith saiu da noite vermelha que seguiu a primeira queda, carregando uma foice de luar. Ele colhe o que o fogo deixou para trás. Quem o enfrenta diz que o chão se enche de sangue antes que alguém seja ferido.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: Morvane the Hollow Crown

p: Morvane was a queen once, of a kingdom that burned in one night. She kept the crown and lost the head beneath it. Her court of wraiths still bows to the empty throne, and they expect you to bow as well.

Morvane foi rainha um dia, de um reino que queimou em uma única noite. Ela ficou com a coroa e perdeu a cabeça que a usava. Sua corte de espectros ainda se curva ao trono vazio, e espera que você se curve também.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: Thalcyra the Stormbound Seer

p: Thalcyra looked into the falling sky to read what came after, and the sky looked back. Now she is the storm she saw. Lightning finds the ground she marks a breath before it falls. Read the marks, or join her vision.

Thalcyra olhou para o céu em queda para ler o que viria depois, e o céu olhou de volta. Agora ela é a tempestade que viu. O raio encontra o chão que ela marca um instante antes de cair. Leia as marcas, ou entre em sua visão.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: The Ascended Omens and the Ember Gate

p: An Omen that is slain does not stay slain. Bind three shards of its herald into a sigil and it returns, Ascended, behind the Ember Gate. The fallen wait in the antechamber for the Gate to let them back. It always does, until it does not.

Um Presságio abatido não continua abatido. Una três fragmentos do seu arauto em um sigilo e ele retorna, Ascendido, atrás do Portão de Brasa. Os caídos esperam na antecâmara até que o Portão os deixe voltar. Ele sempre deixa, até o dia em que não deixa.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: Ysgrath the Cinderheart

p: Every Omen sings of one thing: the first Cinder, the one that never cooled. It has a name now, Ysgrath, and a heartbeat you can feel through the soles of your boots. It remembers the red night, the hollow court and the storm, because it made them. Only those who have ended all three may stand before it.

Todo Presságio canta sobre uma só coisa: a primeira Brasa, a que nunca esfriou. Agora ela tem um nome, Ysgrath, e um batimento que se sente pela sola das botas. Ela lembra a noite vermelha, a corte oca e a tempestade, porque foi ela que os criou. Só quem encerrou os três pode ficar diante dela.

entries.sub: Omens

entries.name: The Ashen Sepulchre

p: The Sepulchre was not built to honour a king. It was built to hold one. Varkhul, the Ashen Sovereign, ruled until the fire made him something that would not die, and his own wardens walled him in with everything that served him. Gravewarden Ulthar still keeps the first gate. Morwen the Ash-Sister still sings. The last door opens from the inside.

O Sepulcro não foi construído para honrar um rei. Foi construído para prendê-lo. Varkhul, o Soberano Cinzento, reinou até que o fogo o transformou em algo que não morre, e seus próprios guardiões o emparedaram com tudo o que o servia. O Guardião de Túmulos Ulthar ainda vigia o primeiro portão. Morwen, a Irmã das Cinzas, ainda canta. A última porta se abre por dentro.

entries.sub: The Ashen Sepulchre

entries.name: Kaelgor the Infernal Warlord

p: Kaelgor led the first army through a burning rift and found nothing on the other side worth conquering, so he conquers ours, again and again. His banner is a sheet of flame. His soldiers are whoever he killed last time.

Kaelgor liderou o primeiro exército através de uma fenda em chamas e não encontrou do outro lado nada que valesse conquistar; então conquista o nosso, de novo e de novo. Seu estandarte é uma cortina de fogo. Seus soldados são quem ele matou da última vez.

entries.sub: World bosses

entries.name: Skaldra the Rime Queen

p: Where a Cinder fell into the northern ice, the ice did not melt. It woke. Skaldra wears the cold like a gown and freezes the sky wherever she descends. She hates the fire more than any of us. That does not make her a friend.

Onde uma Brasa caiu no gelo do norte, o gelo não derreteu. Ele despertou. Skaldra veste o frio como um vestido e congela o céu onde quer que desça. Ela odeia o fogo mais do que qualquer um de nós. Isso não a torna uma aliada.

entries.sub: World bosses

entries.name: The Rotmother

p: The plague pits were dug for the dead of the first fall. Something kept feeding on them after the digging stopped, and grew, and gave birth. The Thornbound Circle burns its brood on sight and still cannot find the pit it crawls out of.

As covas da peste foram cavadas para os mortos da primeira queda. Algo continuou se alimentando deles depois que pararam de cavar, e cresceu, e deu à luz. O Círculo dos Espinhos queima sua ninhada assim que a vê e ainda não encontrou a cova de onde ela rasteja.

entries.sub: World bosses

entries.name: Nyxareth the Void Archon

p: The Veiled Choir sang to the void for a hundred nights. On the hundred and first, the void sang back, and Nyxareth stepped out of the tear. The Choir calls it a misunderstanding. The Vigil calls it a debt.
O Coro Velado cantou para o vazio por cem noites. Na centésima primeira, o vazio cantou de volta, e Nyxareth saiu do rasgo. O Coro chama isso de mal-entendido. A Vigília chama de dívida.

entries.sub: World bosses

entries.name: Vharok the Blood Colossus

p: Vharok is what a battlefield becomes when no one buries the fallen. Every war since the first fall added to him. When the earth trembles, he is counting the new dead.
Vharok é o que um campo de batalha se torna quando ninguém enterra os caídos. Cada guerra desde a primeira queda aumentou seu corpo. Quando a terra treme, ele está contando os novos mortos.

entries.sub: World bosses

entries.name: The Ember Descent

p: Under every town there is a stair that was not there before the fall. It goes down further each time someone walks it. The rooms change. The heat does not. No one has found the bottom, and those who claim to have found it do not go back.

Sob cada cidade há uma escada que não existia antes da queda. Ela desce mais a cada vez que alguém a percorre. As salas mudam. O calor não. Ninguém encontrou o fundo, e quem diz ter encontrado não volta lá.

entries.sub: The deep places

entries.name: The Wardens of the Deep

p: Past the reach of any map lie places the fire hollowed out on its own: the Emberdeep Hollows, the Sunken Ossuary, the Cinderfall Wastes, the Hollow Vault. Each has a keeper grown fat on Cinder heat: the Emberdeep Maw, the Ossuary Warden, Cinderwing, and Vault Keeper Ossrim, who still counts coins no one will spend.

Além do alcance de qualquer mapa ficam lugares que o fogo escavou sozinho: Emberdeep Hollows, Sunken Ossuary, Cinderfall Wastes e The Hollow Vault. Cada um tem um guardião engordado pelo calor das Brasas: The Emberdeep Maw, The Ossuary Warden, Cinderwing e Vault Keeper Ossrim, que ainda conta moedas que ninguém vai gastar.

entries.sub: The deep places

entries.name: The Four Deeper Doors

p: Below the Vault the fire kept digging. The Marrow Crypts, where Ossivane the Gravecage walks on the ribs of a dead giant. The Iron Crucible, whose Forgewarden Kharzun still guards a forge no hand works. The Fallen Sanctum, where Vaelith sings what is left of a hymn. And last the Pyre Throne, where Azhkarrath, mother of the pyrewings, lies chained to the seat she burned. Each door opens to one at a time.

Abaixo do Vault o fogo continuou cavando. The Marrow Crypts, onde Ossivane the Gravecage anda sobre as costelas de um gigante morto. The Iron Crucible, cujo Forgewarden Kharzun ainda guarda uma forja que nenhuma mão trabalha. The Fallen Sanctum, onde Vaelith canta o que restou de um hino. E por último The Pyre Throne, onde Azhkarrath, mãe dos pyrewings, jaz acorrentada ao trono que queimou. Cada porta se abre para um de cada vez.

entries.sub: The deep places

entries.name: The Cellars of Cinderhold

p: Cinderhold was built on top of an older town, and the older town was built on its cellars. The Archivist keeps the overflow of her ledger down there, in dry rooms the rats think are theirs. Every year she loses a king or two to their teeth, and every year she writes them again from memory.

Cinderhold foi construída sobre uma cidade mais antiga, e a cidade mais antiga foi construída sobre seus porões. A Arquivista guarda lá embaixo o que não cabe em seu registro, em salas secas que os ratos acham que são deles. Todo ano ela perde um rei ou dois para os dentes deles, e todo ano os escreve de novo de memória.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Lantern Road

p: Before the Cinders, the Ashen Vigil lit a lantern on every grave between the towns, so the dead would know the way to rest. The road of lights ran from coast to coast. The night the sky split, every lantern went out at once, and the dead have been walking the dark road ever since, looking for the next light.
At its end stands a roost of stone watchers, and past them, a circle of open graves.

Antes das Brasas, a Vigília Cinzenta acendia uma lanterna em cada túmulo entre as cidades, para que os mortos soubessem o caminho do descanso. A estrada de luzes ia de costa a costa. Na noite em que o céu se partiu, todas as lanternas se apagaram de uma vez, e desde então os mortos andam pela estrada escura procurando a próxima luz.
No fim dela há um poleiro de vigias de pedra e, além deles, um círculo de túmulos abertos.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Grave Circle

p: Some saw the Cinders as a curse. The Grave Circle saw them as a gift: a fire that wakes the dead is a fire that can be taught. Its necromancers raise bonebeasts from the Vigil's own graves, and their liches and banshees keep a list of every name the Circle means to wake. The Archivist's name was on it. So, they say, was yours.

Alguns viram as Brasas como uma maldição. O Círculo das Covas as viu como um presente: um fogo que desperta os mortos é um fogo que pode ser ensinado. Seus necromantes erguem bestas de ossos dos próprios túmulos da Vigília, e seus liches e banshees mantêm uma lista de cada nome que o Círculo pretende despertar. O nome da Arquivista estava nela. O seu também, dizem.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Dragon Census

p: The Veiled Choir counts dragons the way farmers count clouds. A brood that grows means a hot year and burning fields; a brood that shrinks means something larger is eating them. The census is sung, never written, so the Archivist keeps the only copy on paper. She binds it with rune shards, because dragon fire eats ordinary glue.

O Coro Velado conta dragões como fazendeiros contam nuvens. Uma ninhada que cresce significa um ano quente e campos queimando; uma ninhada que diminui significa que algo maior está comendo os dragões. O censo é cantado, nunca escrito, então a Arquivista guarda a única cópia em papel. Ela a encaderna com fragmentos rúnicos, porque o fogo de dragão come cola comum.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Moon-Sick

p: Under a Cinder moon some hunters do not come home as hunters. The Thornbound Circle calls them the moon-sick and keeps a place at its table for each of them, in case they return. None ever has. Bramwyn says they run from something in the marsh, a mother of a hundred heads, and that the moon only shows them the way.

Sob uma lua de Brasa, alguns caçadores não voltam para casa como caçadores. O Círculo Espinhoso os chama de enfermos da lua e mantém um lugar à mesa para cada um deles, caso voltem. Nenhum voltou. Bramwyn diz que fogem de algo no pântano, uma mãe de cem cabeças, e que a lua apenas lhes mostra o caminho.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Bone Court

p: Long before the Ashen Sepulchre had its Sovereign, the Bone Court had its own king, and a court of archers, berserkers and masters who served him past death. The Vigil buried them twice. The Cinders woke them twice. Their records are sealed now in the Archivist's ledger with rune shards, so that the court is only a page, and pages do not march.

Muito antes de o Sepulcro Cinzento ter seu Soberano, a Corte de Ossos tinha seu próprio rei, e uma corte de arqueiros, berserkers e mestres que o serviram além da morte. A Vigília os enterrou duas vezes. As Brasas os despertaram duas vezes. Seus registros agora estão selados no registro da Arquivista com fragmentos rúnicos, para que a corte seja só uma página, e páginas não marcham.

entries.sub: The world

entries.name: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: The ash has always fallen on the broken world. This season it falls heavier and warmer, and Archivist Maelis, the Chronicler, has opened a new book. What the whole realm does together is written in it, and the world answers.

One chapter is open at a time. The whole realm writes it: every world boss slain, rift sealed, Omen and Ascended Omen defeated, Ashen Sepulchre cleared, character reaching a level and world event won counts for the chapter whose goal it is. When every goal is met the chapter is written and the world changes. Adventure > Chronicle shows the bars, your part and the top contributors.

rows: II. The Wound Beside the Walls

p: The Chronicler records the top contributors of every chapter: the client's Record tab and the website's Chronicle page keep them. The next season starts a new book, and the world changes of this one are taken back.
A Crônica das Cinzas: Temporada das Cinzas

As cinzas sempre caíram sobre o mundo partido. Nesta temporada elas caem mais grossas e mais quentes, e a Arquivista Maelis, a Cronista, abriu um livro novo. O que o reino inteiro fizer junto será escrito nele, e o mundo vai responder.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle

entries.name: I. The Ash Thickens

p: The ash falls warm to the touch now, and in the capital's streets the wind no longer carries it away. Beyond the walls the small rifts open faster than the Vigil's wardens can count them.
The Chronicler has written one line on the first page: "The world remembers what it does." Turn the keys. Seal the small wounds before they learn to grow, and let the new hunters find their strength.
Ash drifts and scorched cracks now mark the ground around the capital's temple.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
I. As Cinzas se Adensam
Agora as cinzas caem mornas, e nas ruas da capital o vento já não as leva embora. Além das muralhas, as fendas pequenas se abrem mais rápido do que os guardiões da Vigília conseguem contar.

A Cronista escreveu uma única linha na primeira página: "O mundo se lembra do que faz." Girem as chaves. Selem as feridas pequenas antes que aprendam a crescer, e deixem que os novos caçadores descubram a própria força.
Montes de cinza e rachaduras queimadas agora marcam o chão em volta do templo da capital.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

entries.name: II. The Wound Beside the Walls

p: Where the Five last fell, the ground did not close. A seam of cinders runs beside the capital's walls, and Kaelgor, Skaldra, the Rotmother, Nyxareth and Vharok come back through the temple portals angrier each time.
Break them, again and again. Seal the deeper rifts that feed the seam. When it is quiet enough to walk into, the wardens will open the way.
The Cinderscar Breach is open: its gate stands by the capital's temple. Rubble from the Five's last assault lies near the temple.
The Cinderscar Breach opens (level 400 and above): its gate appears in the world.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
II. A Ferida ao Lado das Muralhas

Onde os Cinco caíram pela última vez, o chão não se fechou. Um veio de brasas corre ao lado das muralhas da capital, e Kaelgor, Skaldra, a Mãe Podre, Nyxareth e Vharok voltam pelos portais dos templos cada vez mais furiosos.
Derrubem-nos quantas vezes for preciso. Selem as fendas mais fundas que alimentam o veio. Quando ele estiver calmo o bastante para alguém entrar, os guardiões vão abrir o caminho.
A Cinderscar Breach está aberta: o portão fica junto ao templo da capital. Escombros do último ataque dos Cinco estão perto do templo.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

entries.name: III. Omens in the Ashfall

p: Sangrith's blood moon has been seen over the rifts, Morvane's hollow crown in the ash clouds, Thalcyra's storm in the deepest tiers. The Omens are no longer waiting behind their keys.
Press the fragments into keys, walk into their arenas and put them down before what they foretell arrives. Light the ward-fires when they fall.
Ward-fires burn around the capital's temple.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
III. Presságios na Chuva de Cinzas

A lua de sangue de Sangrith foi vista sobre as fendas, a coroa oca de Morvane nas nuvens de cinza, a tempestade de Thalcyra nos níveis mais profundos. Os Presságios já não esperam atrás das suas chaves.
Prensem os fragmentos em chaves, entrem nas arenas deles e derrubem-nos antes que chegue o que eles anunciam. Acendam as fogueiras de guarda quando eles caírem.
Fogueiras de guarda queimam em volta do templo da capital.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

entries.name: IV. The Sepulchre Stirs

p: Beneath the capital, the Ashen Sepulchre breathes. What was walled in with Varkhul no longer sleeps between one raid and the next; at night its bones knock against a sealed stair under the city.
Clear the Sepulchre, face the Ascended forms of the Omens, and the stair the old wardens walled up will be ours to walk.
The Ossuary Stair below the capital is open: its gate stands by the capital's temple.
The Ossuary Stair opens (level 380 and above): its gate appears in the world.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
IV. O Sepulcro Desperta
Embaixo da capital, o Sepulcro Cinzento respira. O que foi emparedado junto com Varkhul já não dorme entre uma incursão e outra; de noite, seus ossos batem contra uma escada selada sob a cidade.
Limpem o Sepulcro, enfrentem as formas Ascendidas dos Presságios, e a escada que os antigos guardiões muraram será nossa para descer.
A Ossuary Stair, embaixo da capital, está aberta: o portão fica junto ao templo da capital.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

entries.name: V. Embers Rekindled

p: Ysgrath the Cinderheart is the first Cinder, the one that never cooled, and while it beats the ash will never stop. Bind its sigil from the relics of the Ascended, gather the strong, and hold the towns when the invaders come.
When the Cinderheart falls, carry what is left of its flame back to the Great Brazier. Let the capital remember that it was rebuilt, not spared.
The capital is rebuilt: the ash and rubble are cleared and flowers grow where the cracks were.
The capital changes around its temple.
Earlier scars of the capital are cleared away.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
V. Brasas Reacesas

Ysgrath, o Coração de Brasa, é a primeira Brasa, a que nunca esfriou, e enquanto ela pulsar as cinzas não vão parar de cair. Unam o seu sigilo com as relíquias dos Ascendidos, reúnam os fortes e defendam as cidades quando os invasores vierem.
Quando o Coração de Brasa cair, levem o que restar da sua chama de volta ao Grande Braseiro. Que a capital se lembre de que foi reconstruída, e não poupada.
A capital foi reconstruída: as cinzas e os escombros sumiram, e há flores onde ficavam as rachaduras.

entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

entries.name: The Ember Memorial

p: A plaza in the capital keeps the season: guardian statues for its realm firsts, statues for its records and memorial stones for the heroes who fell in Hardcore. Look at one to read it. A stone in the middle says what is remembered; when there are more names than statues, they turn every 10 minutes.

Every name is there by its player's choice (Adventure > Chronicle > Memorial): records and realm firsts are shown unless you turn them off, a Hardcore fall only after your yes, asked at the next login after the fall. You can change it any time. Each season starts a new Memorial; the website keeps the past ones.

Uma praça na capital guarda a temporada: estátuas de guardião para as primeiras vitórias do reino, estátuas para os recordes e pedras memoriais para os heróis que caíram no Hardcore. Cada nome está lá por escolha do jogador: recordes e primeiras vitórias aparecem, a menos que você desligue; uma queda no Hardcore só depois do seu sim. Você pode mudar quando quiser.
